description: Effective values of Project/Golden.fomain derived by hand from the Engine parsers and their tests, not from fo_formats output.

config.derivation: Source/Common/ConfigFile.cpp continuation and quote rules, Source/Common/Settings.cpp ResolveSettingValue ($FILE relative to the config directory, trimmed) and SetValue; Test_ConfigFile PreservesCommentCharactersInsideDoubleQuotes and StoresViewsIntoOwnedInput.

config_smoke.derivation: Settings.cpp AddSubConfigs merges parents first, ApplySubConfigSection applies a leading + as append, ApplyIgnoreInputDirs removes the input relative to the declaring config.

prototype_files.derivation: DiskFileSystem.cpp recursive_dir_look skips names starting with . or ~ and directories starting with _; FileSystem::FilterFiles applies ExcludePatterns; ProtoBaker keeps Baking.ProtoFileExtensions.

prototypes.derivation: ProtoBaker.cpp fill_parent_recursive: parents left to right after their own ancestors, child last, a repeated ancestor applies where first reached (Test_ProtoBaker AppliesRepeatedProtoParentOnce); $Name defaults to the file stem; nested [$Name/...] sections are skipped; parent names pass CheckMigrationRule, which follows Rename chains.

prototype_texts.derivation: ProtoTextBaker.cpp: $Text keys inherit like properties, the value passes StringEscaping::DecodeString, unknown languages are dropped, then TextPack::FixPacks fills russ from engl (Test_ProtoTextBaker BakesProtoTextPacksByTypeLanguageAndInheritedParents).

text_packs.derivation: TextPack::LoadFromString keeps duplicate keys as ordered variants and joins multiline text with newlines; FixPacks gives a missing key the first base variant and removes keys the base lacks (Test_TextPack FixStrAddsMissingAndRemovesUnknownKeys).
